SELECT
    e.event AS previous_event,
    e.severity AS previous_severity,
    e.status AS previous_status,
    e.timestamp AS previous_timestamp,
    e.message AS previous_message,
    e.created_at AS previous_created_at,
    e.details AS previous_details
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        event,
        severity,
        status,
        timestamp,
        message,
        created_at,
        details
    FROM hestia_events
    WHERE source = 'docker_guardian'
      AND component = 'docker'
      AND details->>'container_name' = '{{ $json.details.container_name }}'
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) e ON TRUE;
